sources.title: Children as Advocates: The Bread and Roses Strike of 1912

moments.title: Police response draws public attention
moments.facts: Police trying to prevent children of striking workers from leaving Lawrence injured children and arrested mothers. The incident drew national attention.
moments.interpretation: An attempt to contain the strike made its human cost visible and widened public scrutiny.

moments.title: Cross-group solidarity wins concessions
moments.facts: The strike led to improvements in wages, conditions, and work hours. The nearby Lowell strike won an industry-wide raise after broad solidarity among workers.
moments.interpretation: Solidarity across language, gender, and skill lines made it harder to isolate one group of workers.
